name: addpipe24_ks_fused_window8
rationale: Fusing KS stride-1+stride-2 into one flat sliding-window SOP (attempt_013, window4) cut area from 549.8->534.66 while keeping WNS close to full-KS (7.486 vs 7.517), continuing a trend where flat/fused expressions synthesize more efficiently than explicitly staged 2-input combines. This candidate extends that fusion one step further: it fuses the first THREE KS stages (stride 1,2,4) into a single flat, sliding-window generate/propagate SOP spanning 8 bits per position (using boundary-safe identity padding, G=0/P=1, for out-of-range virtual predecessors to avoid the indexing bug seen in the earlier block-aligned radix4 attempt), then finishes with only 2 remaining canonical KS doublings (stride 8, stride 16) instead of 4. This should reduce total combine-node count/area further versus the window4-fused design while ABC still has a single large boolean cone to rebalance for the fused portion, aiming for a new area/WNS point below 534.66 area while keeping WNS near 7.48, seeking a possible new non-dominated frontier point or a reward closer to baseline.
